name: dirac
description: Reduces API costs by more than 50%, produces better and faster work. Uses Hash anchored parallel edits, AST manipulation and a whole lot of neat optimizations. Fully Open Source.
notes: Documented ACP env authentication: DIRAC_PROVIDER/MODEL/API_KEY/BASE_URL select an OpenAI-compatible provider pointed at the mock LLM — overrides persisted defaults for the ACP process, no `dirac auth` needed.
